capabilities: Create checked and unchecked checkboxes from the keyboard
Toggle checkbox status with a shortcut
Paste a clipboard URL as a link wrapping the current selection
Insert local or relative vault links with a shortcut
intentEvidence: port some of my favorite richtext editor shortcuts from Notion to Obsidian
motivation: The author wanted to bring their favorite rich text editor shortcuts from Notion into Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian lacks Notion-style keyboard shortcuts for common editing actions like creating checkboxes, pasting links over a selection, and toggling underline.

relations.evidence: port some of my favorite richtext editor shortcuts from Notion to Obsidian

summary: Keyboard shortcut plugin that ports Notion-style rich text editing shortcuts to Obsidian for checkboxes, links, and underline.
